decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as otherwise varied by the conditions below or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the plans referenced for the ground floor wall opening, the details of the fixing of the posts to the head of wall and the finishing of the plaster around the opening shall be submitted by the consent holder to the Local Planning Authority and approved prior to the commencement of works. The area of demolition shall be restricted to 100mm in any direction from the structural opening.

Condition : 5 - The opening of the fireplace at ground floor for the installation of the AGA cooker, shall not exceed 1.3m in width and 1.8m in height. Prior to the commencement of works the details of support and finishing of the opening shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for approval by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 6 - Details of any new openings for services, water and waste disposal and ventilation to include materials, at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted by the consent holder to the Local Planning Authority and approved before the commencement of works.
description: General refurbishment to include internal and external redecorations and new opening through ground floor spine wall to match existing first floor opening; new enlarged opening to rear ground floor chimney breast to accommodate an AGA.
